svg.title: Margin MongoDB collection relationships
svg.desc: Nine actual collections. Each ObjectId reference points to a labelled repeated target collection. Dashed arrows show the audit target selected by targetType.
svg.text: Main database: academic_marketplace · Models and live collections checked · 18 November 2026
Solid arrow: field references _id in the named collection. Small target boxes repeat the same collection.
Many source documents may reference one target. ? = optional. * = targetType selects the audit target. Important fields only.
